question: Which divine figures preside at Arvuda and on the Śveta river?
premises: Cārvude locates the first site at Arvuda.
Vaśiṣṭhaś is the presiding figure there.
Śvetanadyāṃ names the second sacred site.
Manobhavaḥ is the presiding figure there.
inference: Vaśiṣṭha presides at Arvuda and Manobhava presides on the Śveta river.
plain_english: At Arvuda is Vaśiṣṭha, and on the Śveta river is Manobhava.
